content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

⚠️ Lower back soreness after deadlifts is common, but don't push through it blindly. If it's a dull, muscle-type ache that fades in a day or two, lower the weight 20-30%, tighten your form (brace hard, keep the bar close, neutral spine, no rounding at the bottom), and stay in a pain-free range. If the pain is sharp, shoots into your glute or leg, causes numbness, or lasts more than a few days, stop deadlifting and get it checked by a doctor or physio.
